notes.title: Update Notes for BlastFort 1.6.4.1
notes.content: [list][*]Added the ultimate achievement: Get a score of 100,000 in singleplayer in the Hell Scape map using only an Assault Rifle and Grenades, while not catching fire at all! (we're not even sure if that's possible)[*]Fixed issues with multiplayer crashing for peers for no reason[*]Added support for custom WebRTC WebSocket servers to ensure future compatibility (Officially Supported Signaling Server)[*]Fixed an issue causing Forcefields/Grenades to not work correctly in multiplayer on touch devices[*]Updated physics iterations for Forcefields/Grenades[*]Fixed a bug causing the game to hang upon the games end due to repeated snapshots[*]Fixed a bug causing the on screen keyboard to display the wrong selector over the space bar[/list]

tags.feature: Added the ultimate achievement: Get a score of 100,000 in singleplayer in the Hell Scape map using only an Assault Rifle and Grenades, while not catching fire at all! (we're not even sure if that's possible)

tags.bug: Fixed issues with multiplayer crashing for peers for no reason

tags.feature: Added support for custom WebRTC WebSocket servers to ensure future compatibility (Officially Supported Signaling Server)

tags.bug: Fixed an issue causing Forcefields/Grenades to not work correctly in multiplayer on touch devices
Fixed a bug causing the game to hang upon the games end due to repeated snapshots
Fixed a bug causing the on screen keyboard to display the wrong selector over the space bar
